quickInfo.name: Center grid
quickInfo.summary: The 4-by-3 grid records the six drop targets, three top lanes, and three captive-ball hits.

quickInfo.name: Grid lines
quickInfo.summary: A completed row scores 25,000, while a completed column scores 50,000.

quickInfo.name: A-T-T-I-L-A drops
quickInfo.summary: Each of the six drop targets fills its matching grid position and adds base bonus.

quickInfo.name: H-U-N lanes
quickInfo.summary: Completing the three top lanes advances the bonus multiplier as well as filling the grid.

quickInfo.name: T-H-E captive ball
quickInfo.summary: Three captive-ball hits complete T-H-E and advance the bonus multiplier.

steps.text: Before plunging, read the center grid and choose the H-U-N lane that advances the best column.
Plunge for that needed H-U-N lane.
When the ball reaches a flipper, identify the shortest unfinished 50,000-point column.
Hit only the A-T-T-I-L-A drop target or captive-ball letter needed for that column.
Send a controlled ball back to the top when a missing H-U-N lane is the next column item.
After completing a column, choose the next line with the most already-filled positions.
Complete H-U-N or T-H-E when either set is one shot from a bonus-multiplier advance.
Once the bonus is strong, favor the safe spinner route and protect the end-of-ball value.

fallback.title: Safe spinner survival
fallback.when: Use this plan when the needed drop or captive-ball rebound is not controllable.

steps.text: Stop shooting the exposed target that returned dangerously.
Use the spinner route to move the ball away from the lower targets.
Read the center grid while the ball is in the upper playfield.
Resume the main plan only after the ball returns to a controlled flipper.

alternatives.title: Finish a 25,000-point row
alternatives.when: Use this plan when a row needs one item and every column needs several.

steps.text: Identify the row with exactly one empty grid position.
Match that position to its drop target, top lane, or captive-ball hit.
Take the single completion shot.
Return to column-first planning after the row scores.
Fill grid positions by collecting all six A-T-T-I-L-A drops.
Complete all three H-U-N top lanes.
Complete three T-H-E captive-ball hits.
Take 50,000-point columns before 25,000-point rows when both are available.
Protect the accumulated end-of-ball bonus after the high-value lines are complete.

techniques.name: Grid-first shot selection
techniques.instruction: Read the center grid before each controlled shot. Choose the item that completes a column or leaves one item in a column.

techniques.name: Balanced objective rotation
techniques.instruction: Move among the drops, top lanes, and captive ball instead of repeating an item whose grid position is already filled.

techniques.name: Spinner escape
techniques.instruction: Use the spinner when an exposed scoring target has produced an unsafe rebound and the ball needs a safer route upward.

cautions.response: Shoot the captive ball only for an unfilled grid position or a needed T-H-E completion, then track the rebound immediately.
Do not repeat a completed letter. Shoot only the target that improves the current grid line and abandon the bank after a dangerous return.

cautions.issue: Repeating one feature leaves the high-value grid incomplete.
cautions.response: Spread shots across all three objective groups and prioritize columns, which score twice as much as rows.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm the exact 1984 Game Plan game, ball count, Bonus X, Extra Ball, Special, and replay treatment.
Read the center grid and verify that every A-T-T-I-L-A, H-U-N, and T-H-E lamp registers before planning a line.
Test the captive-ball and drop-target rebounds, spinner return, upper-playfield exits, and tilt sensitivity before choosing the route.

input.simpleOverview: Attila the Hun fills a center grid from six A-T-T-I-L-A drops, three H-U-N lanes, and three captive-ball hits. Spread shots among those three groups, prioritize completed 50,000-point columns over 25,000-point rows, and preserve the resulting end-of-ball bonus.
input.overview: Attila the Hun records six A-T-T-I-L-A drops, three H-U-N lanes, and three T-H-E captive-ball hits in a four-by-three grid. Complete each group while seeking 50,000-point columns before 25,000-point rows; the H-U-N lanes and captive ball also advance Bonus X. After the valuable lines are complete, protect the accumulated end-of-ball bonus.
